title: Colombo Tea Auction: price in LKR (real, public)
description: One row per auction price quote. Predict the mid auction price (LKR/kg) from catalogue, grade, tier, region, exchange rate and lagged weather.
target_definition: price_mid_lkr = (low price + high price) / 2 for the quote, in LKR per kg; 3.6% of rows have no price and are dropped.
known_limitations: Rows from the same weekly sale are correlated; random cross-validation is optimistic compared with forecasting the next week.
Many 'unknown' values in grade, tier and segment.
provenance: Public dataset: Hugging Face 'colombo-tea-auction-prices/cta-price-prediction' (revision a671701), extracted from 105 weekly Forbes & Walker Tea Brokers reports, with Open-Meteo weather. Paper: 'Forecasting Weather-Driven Price Dynamics Across Sri Lankan Tea Market Catalogues' (MERCon 2026).
context: Genuine Sri Lankan market data: the Colombo Tea Auction, one of the world's largest tea auctions, with weather for the growing regions.

features.catalogue: Market catalogue: low_grown, high_grown, dust or off_grade
features.category: Tea category within the catalogue (e.g. bop, fbop, pekoe)
features.elevation: Elevation group (low_grown, high_grown, low, medium, high)
features.grade: Leaf grade (e.g. bop, bopf, op; often 'unknown')
features.tier: Quality tier (select_best, best, below_best, others; often 'unknown')
features.price_mid_lkr: Mid auction price in LKR per kg ((low + high) / 2)
features.region: Growing region used for the weather join
features.text_crop_change: Crop intake direction parsed from the broker report text
features.text_keywords: Weather keywords parsed from the broker report text
features.temperature_2m_mean_mean: Mean temperature in the auction week (C)
features.precipitation_sum_total_lag1: Total rainfall 1 week before the auction (mm)
features.sale_date_raw: Auction date as printed in the report (free text)
features.avg_weather_severity: Composite weather severity score from the report text

anonymisation: Market prices only; no personal data.
